cd.title: 14 months at 4% APY
cd.inputs: Deposit $10,000 for fourteen months at a hypothetical 4% APY. No additional deposits, withdrawals, penalty or modeled tax.
steps: Set Deposit length to zero years and Additional months to fourteen.
Maturity = 10,000 × 1.04^(14/12). APY already includes compounding.
Subtract the initial deposit to find interest; the monthly schedule is accrued growth, not a payout.

mutual-fund.title: Annual expense rises to 2%
mutual-fund.inputs: Start with $10,000 and add $100 at each month end for ten years at an assumed 5% gross annual return. Entry load 3%; annual operating expense 2%; final-balance exit charge 0%.
steps: Reduce each contribution by the entered entry-load percentage.
Apply the monthly equivalent of (1 + gross return) × (1 − annual expense).
Apply the exit-charge percentage to the final balance only; the gap from the no-charge case includes lost growth.

investment-fee.title: 0.20% fund fee; no advisor fee
investment-fee.inputs: Start with $10,000 and add $1,000 at each year end for twenty years. Entered return 8%, before fund fees. Fund fee A 0.20%, advisor fee 0%; no sales load or tax is modeled.
steps: Apply the stated return, then only fees not already embedded in that return, before adding the year-end contribution.
Track actual additional charges separately from the balance reduction that includes their lost growth.
Hold deposits and return conventions fixed when comparing fee options.
